scope: Development-only bounded source-backed Sales follow-up/reorder proposals and single-SKU Marketing readiness evidence; not a whole-app redesign or executable cart/campaign.

featureMapping.scope: Native opportunity/lead entities; Sale own+unassigned versus existing team scope. Existing CRM activities are retained. Company identity is not guessed from a lead/account.
Native Josh companies and orders, same assignment predicate/payment rule. New narrow read-only planning projections add no contact/credit/KYC fields.
One canonical task-index entry. A private human-reviewed proposal using company/order evidence; no contact completion or order placement.
Native catalog and existing live campaign planning/execution capabilities retained. They are not removed as duplicate single-SKU evidence reviews.
One canonical task-index entry; recorded single-SKU readiness findings and a private campaign brief. No campaign activation.

permissions.serverAuthority: Original global StaffAuthGuard verifies active database account and password state on each request. New routes derive actor/scope from req.staff, never body/JWT role claim or a client rep override.
permissions.SalesOwnScope: Original SalesRepIdentity and repScopeSql company assignment; empty identity never broadens to team. Admin/manager use their existing team company scope. This differs from native Winback own+unassigned opportunity/lead authority.
permissions.SalesRetainedEvidence: Private read/list/request/committed replay rechecks current company authorization. Reassignment cannot expose old company/order evidence. An inaccessible source 404 is not a missing receipt.

sales.source: Replica-only narrow company projection, original copies/replica order readers. planningOrders uses paidOrderSql or copied o.paid plus current company assignment, not status alone.
sales.coverage: Latest returned history page, bounded 20 rows; hasMore explicitly indicates incomplete coverage. Selected detail must match authorized company and be in that page. No cadence, complete history or suggested interval inferred.
sales.eligibility: Confirmed assignment for follow-up. Reorder requires source-paid true AND paid/preparing/shipped/delivered status, correct company/order identity and unambiguous positive-quantity historical lines. Duplicate SKUs and invalid quantities excluded with reasons; >50 lines blocks instead of silent truncation.
sales.proposal: Reviewer explicitly enters quantity. Historical unit absent; current customer price, available-to-promise and current total null. Historical amounts never become execution prices. Proposal is not an executable cart.
sales.reasons: Human-entered source-based reason and optional chosen UTC review date; no automatic cadence/date/assignment/margin recommendations.
remaining: Sale persistence remains unavailable under global GET-only policy; any future scope decision must be explicit.
Operational assignment workflow audit remains separate.
Authoritative historical-to-selling UOM, current customer price and ATP required before any reviewed cart.
Individual CRM follow-up history/company-account mapping still unverified.

marketing.source: Existing JoshProducts list/detail, including original owned overlays and copies/replica selection. Projection excludes buying_price/cost and private contact fields.
marketing.knownIssues: Inactive/missing-price/image/category/empty-stock/unknown-stock/backorder confirmation recorded as review findings. A private brief may retain blocked evidence.
marketing.readiness: Only blocked or needs_confirmation. Never ready-to-activate. Actual margin/ROAS/current order total remain null. Source changed-at and capture time do not establish upstream synchronization or live inventory.
remaining: Multi-product campaign readiness and time/budget rules
Existing live campaign orchestration remains outside this pass

persistence.partition: scenario.kind sales_work or marketing_readiness plus authenticated actor. Promotion/Pack/Goal records stay isolated.
protocol: Same actor/request advisory lock as existing draft kinds
Strict immutable request hash; different packet conflicts
Draft and durable receipt in one transaction
Committed replay keeps original revision/evidence but still checks current company authorization
persistence.unknownStorage: 503 plus recovery guidance if existing tables or source unavailable. No production setup attempted.

interaction.components: Shared factory workspace, evidence panel, form backup and immutable owner/kind request journal using existing @cp/ui controls and CommercePage.
interaction.URLs: Source, proposal, review, saved detail/edit and request recovery are distinct navigable actions. Step back/forward retains forms.
interaction.success: Validated persisted receipt or current persisted draft read establishes saved badge. Counts are returned persisted rows, never completed contacts/messages/orders/campaigns.
interaction.recovery: Verified local request storage before dispatch; synchronous duplicate lock; reconcile original request. Only PLAN_REQUEST_ABSENT permits same-body/key retry. 400/403/404/409 failed intents require fresh review. Unknown/revoked-source reads never enable blind retry.
interaction.interrupted: Late preview ignored after input/source intent change; navigation interruption does not force redirect. Stale backups require explicit latest/copy choice with latest revision and freshly matching source fingerprint.
interaction.accessibility: Labeled controls, inline validation, aria-current step navigation, keyboard focus/action links, status announcements, skeletons, useful empty/error/retry states, fluid Thai/English mobile/desktop layout.

protected.welcome: /j/marketing/welcome-lead-email including legacy nav, CSS, fonts, API retained. App/landing have additive routes only.
protected.Claude: Official CLI authentication remains unavailable; no review run or authentication retry.

verification: /workspace/commerce-ui-audit-20261009/commercial-verification.json; final native/built-browser receipts distinguish synthetic upstream/transport from actual guards and PostgreSQL.
